actions.action: Require receipt confirmation before changing the recorded holder
actions.mechanism: Separate a proposed handoff from confirmed receipt; unanswered proposals remain visibly unresolved rather than silently transferring responsibility.
actions.implementation: Use a shared sheet accessible to both volunteers. Sender records recipient and handoff time; recipient confirms receipt and its time.
actions.check: Propose a transfer without confirmation: the previous confirmed holder remains shown alongside the unresolved transfer. Confirm receipt: the holder changes.
actions.risk: Recorded custody can lag reality; label it “last confirmed holder.”

actions.action: Preserve handoff history instead of overwriting it
actions.mechanism: An append-only handoff log preserves the sequence and makes corrections distinguishable from actual key movements.
actions.implementation: Give each handoff an ID. Record both volunteers, handoff time, and confirmation. Correct mistakes with timestamped entries referencing the original ID.
actions.check: Enter two transfers, then correct an erroneous time. Verify both transfers and the correction remain traceable without creating another transfer.
actions.risk: Manual editing can erase history; enable version history where available.

actions.action: Pin one status view with an unresolved queue
actions.mechanism: A single authoritative summary separates confirmed custody from pending transfers, preventing scattered chat messages from competing as status reports.
actions.implementation: Pin the sheet link in chat. Show last confirmed holder, latest confirmed handoff time, and every unresolved handoff with its age.
actions.check: Create an unanswered handoff and add unrelated chat messages. Both volunteers must still locate the holder and pending handoff through the pin.
actions.risk: An outdated summary misleads; derive it from the log rather than copying.
